# Merik

> Merik is an all-in-one workforce management platform for small and growing businesses — employee management, attendance tracking, leave management, payroll, daily task tracking, clients and invoicing, and asset tracking in one secure company workspace.

Merik replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with a single company workspace. Employees self sign-up, mark their own attendance with geolocated check-in, request leave or work-from-home, log daily tasks and download their own payslips. Attendance and leave data flow directly into monthly payroll, so pay is calculated from the days already recorded rather than re-typed from a spreadsheet.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.merik.in/): Overview of the Merik workforce suite, interactive module tour and ROI calculator.
- [Features](https://www.merik.in/features): Employee management, attendance tracking, leave management, payroll, daily task tracking, company workspaces, digital operations monitoring.
- [How it works](https://www.merik.in/how-it-works): Three-step setup — create a workspace, invite employees, run daily operations.
- [Modules](https://www.merik.in/modules): Employees, attendance, leave & WFH, payroll, daily tasks, performance, clients/projects/quotes/invoices, assets & software, and Digital Operations (uptime, early warnings, incidents, SLA reports, status pages).
- [Pricing](https://www.merik.in/pricing): Free workspace with unlimited employee self sign-up; guided setup available on request.
- [ROI calculator](https://www.merik.in/roi): Interactive estimate of what manual attendance, leave and payroll admin costs per year.
- [Blog](https://www.merik.in/blog/): 60 practical guides — attendance, payroll, leave, tasks, clients, assets and HR, plus application monitoring, API reliability, frontend error detection, observability and proactive incident prevention.

## Key facts

- Pricing: free to start, unlimited employee self sign-up, no setup fee, no card required.
- Setup time: under 5 minutes to create a company workspace.
- Typical customer: small and growing businesses, roughly 5–200 employees.
- Core modules: Employees, Attendance, Leave & WFH, Payroll & Payslips, Daily Tasks, Task Insights, Clients/Projects/Quotes/Invoices, Assets & Software, Performance, Digital Operations.
- Attendance: geolocated check-in and check-out, reverse-geocoded to a readable place name; late marks and half-days applied by configurable rules.
- Payroll: computed server-side (never in the browser) from attendance already recorded; payslips generated and emailed individually or in bulk.
- Task log: daily entries with client, project, time spent, status, blockers and proof links; CSV export; per-project and per-client rollups.
- Time estimation: `predictTime()` is a local similarity model over the company's own task history — not an LLM — and backtests its own weights leave-one-out to minimise median error.
- Security: multi-tenant with isolation enforced in Postgres by row-level security, not only in application code. Roles: superadmin, admin, employee.
- AI: optional and off by default. One server-side function, four fail-closed gates (master switch, per-feature flag, per-tenant grant, monthly call cap). Drafts only — performance summaries and quote drafts, always human-edited. Provider keys stored as AES-GCM ciphertext.
- Digital Operations (monitoring): register websites, web apps and APIs (per client for agencies) and Merik checks them from the outside every few minutes — availability, response time, HTTP status, daily SSL-certificate expiry. Latency and error-rate baselines are measured per monitor over 14 days; deviations raise at most one early warning per asset, carrying a risk score, a separate confidence score and the evidence list. Confirmed failures open incidents auto-assigned to the asset's owner, alerted once by email or Slack with quiet-hours rules. A browser SDK (merik.js, one script tag, no cookies, query strings stripped, server-side redaction) reports JavaScript errors, unhandled rejections and failed requests, grouped by fingerprint per hour. GitHub and Vercel webhooks put deploys on the incident timeline; vendor status feeds (Stripe, Supabase, GitHub, Vercel, Cloudflare, Twilio, OpenAI) explain and suppress dependency-caused incidents. Health scores are SLO error budgets against a declared SLA tier; monthly per-client SLA reports and public token-URL status pages are built in.
- Region: built for Indian small businesses (INR, CTC structures, state Shops & Establishments context), usable anywhere.
- Contact: maresolik@gmail.com
